body_text_excerpt: Destination Travel Collections Experiences + Services About Us Homeowners Travel Blog View Gallery Rosemary Beach "Sea Dog and Jolly Roger" 35 Town Hall Road Main and Carriage House Rosemary Beach, FL Bedrooms 7 Beds 14 Sleeps 19 Full Baths 7 Half Baths 0 HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Located in the heart of Rosemary Beach, just a few blocks from the beach - South of 30A - Courtyard and fountain - Pet-friendly - Carriage house - 7 adult bikes - Grill - Community pools - Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout DETAILS: Escape to Sea Dog and Jolly Roger, an inviting pet-friendly retreat nestled in the heart of Rosemary Beach—only a 4-minute stroll from the sparkling shoreline! This 7-bedroom, 7-bathroom property, including a charming Carriage House, boasts 3,426 square feet of luxurious living space and sleeps 19 guests. Relax in the private courtyard with its tranquil fountain, while the kids enjoy the spacious third-floor loft. With access to community pools and thoughtful amenities, this 3-story home is designed for relaxation and fun. Step onto the rustic front porch and into a welcoming space with 3 inviting bedrooms and a laundry room. The first-floor primary bedroom features a king bed, as well as 2 delightful guest bedrooms with cozy queen beds—all with private bathrooms. A quaint courtyard with comfy seating is the ideal spot for watching dogs run and play. The second floor is the heart of this home, exuding subtle coastal charm with warm wood floors, natural textures, and abundant light. Gather with loved ones in the cozy living area, relax on the white slip-covered furniture, or enjoy a family movie night on the TV. Easily prepare meals in the gourmet kitchen, equipped with high-end appliances, spacious cabinetry, a wine cooler, and sizeable island with built-in gadgets. The breakfast bar seats 3 for coffee and after-beach snacks. A sunlit dining area seats 8 under an iron chandelier with candle-like lighting. Settle into the second-floor primary bedroom, featuring a king bed, TV, private bathroom, and balcony access. From the great room, a double set of French doors open to a wraparound deck with a porch swing, Adirondack chairs, and neighborhood views. A spiral staircase leads to a spacious kid-friendly loft featuring 4 twin beds, 1 twin-over-twin bunk, and a private bathroom. The 2-story Carriage House provides a private retreat with a living room, kitchen, primary bedroom with a king bed, and a loft with 2 twin beds and 1 trundle. There are 2 bathrooms. Enjoy the best of Rosemary Beach at Sea Dog and Jolly Roger! With on-site parking and 7 complimentary bikes, exploring Scenic 30A is a breeze. For beach access, head left on Town Hall Road, follow the path by Pescado Seafood Grill to Water Street, turn left, and continue to Western Green. At the end of the green is the boardwalk and beach! Book now! SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 19): FIRST FLOOR: - Primary Bedroom: King bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only - Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo - Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only SECOND FLOOR: - Primary bedroom: King bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo THIRD FLOOR: - Loft area: 4 Twin Beds, 1 Twin over Twin Bunk Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo CARRIAGE HOUSE: - Primary bedroom: king Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only - Loft: Two Twin Beds with One Trundle Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only You also have access to these fantastic Rosemary Beach amenities: - Coquina Pool: open daily to residents and guests from 9 am to 9 pm. - Sky Pool: open daily to residents and guests from 6 am to 10 pm (Adult Only Hours, 6 am-9 am & 8 pm-10 pm) - Cabana Pool: open daily to residents and guests from 9 am to 9 pm. - Barbados Pool: open daily to residents and guests from 9 am to 9 pm.
